# `events`

Helper: `events({ date, title, detail, kind, open }, ...)`  
Kit (`src/ui`): web-only (kit gap) · status: kit gap (web-only)  
App (KMP `core:ui`): `PemaTile` (core:ui)

## Anatomy

Rows with icon by kind (followup, photo, done), date, bold title, chevron; an open row shows its detail.

## Variants

- `open: true` expands a row

## States

- Closed: detail hidden
- Open: detail below, indented 48

## Tokens

brand-50, brand-500, line, ink, ink-soft

## Do

- Use for "Cập nhật gần đây" on the journey

## Don't

- Do not show the detail of a closed row

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Min row height 72.

## Mobile (390)

Same as 1440; the frame is narrower, nothing is hidden.

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

Journey "Cập nhật gần đây" rows (old `<details>`): icon by `kind` (`followup photo done`), date, bold title, chevron. `open: true` expands that row and shows `detail`; a collapsed row hides its detail like the old page
